disclaimer: Simplified estimate, not payroll-compliance advice. PF is calculated on the Basic Salary field only (a common simplification; real PF law uses Basic+DA, and the statutory PF wage ceiling of Rs 15,000/month is not enforced here). ESI eligibility is an all-or-nothing cliff at Rs 21,000/month gross (Rs 252,000/year): if gross exceeds this, ESI does not apply at all, matching the real rule. Employer-side PF further splits into EPF/EPS internally under real law, which is not modeled since it does not change the employer's total 12% outlay. Gratuity is a separate statutory benefit and is not included in this template. Verify against current EPFO/ESIC notifications before using for real payroll.
